title: Week 5 review + practice exam warmup
topic: Week 5 synthesis: S3 lifecycle, Cost Explorer/Budgets/CUR, Fargate right-sizing and Spot, Step Functions capstone, Well-Architected tiers, cross-week exam traps (security, OLTP vs analytics, integration, NAT cost)
format: 30 timed scenario questions (~48 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-34-week-5-review.md and Nights 30–33. Complete before external 65-question Practice Exam 1. Answer without peeking at night-34-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×8 B×7 C×8 D×7 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Night 30 applied lifecycle to globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-output/iceland/ with transitions at 90 and 365 days. Objects uploaded to iceland/2026-07/ this week remain S3 Standard. Which concept explains why nothing moved on deploy night?

options.A: Lifecycle transitions evaluate object age — rules do not move objects on create night
options.B: Glacier Flexible Retrieval blocks every transition for 30 days across all Regions
options.C: S3 lifecycle rules apply only to objects stored in the us-west-2 Region
options.D: Intelligent-Tiering must be enabled before any lifecycle transition can run

questions.question: Finance needs an email when forecasted monthly spend crosses 80% of a $25 study-account cap. Which service sends that alert?

options.A: Cost Explorer saved report with no notification channel configured
options.B: AWS Budgets with FORECASTED threshold notifications to email or SNS
options.C: S3 Storage Lens dashboard export written nightly into an analysis bucket
options.D: CloudWatch alarm on NAT Gateway BytesOut as the only spend signal

questions.question: CloudWatch shows Iceland Fargate tasks at p95 24% CPU and 38% memory on 2 vCPU / 4 GiB. The team wants to cut compute cost before any 1-year commit. Best first step?

options.A: Buy a Compute Savings Plan sized to the current oversized task definition
options.B: Register a lower CPU/memory task definition revision aligned to utilization
options.C: Move the monthly batch transform onto Aurora Serverless v2 instead of Fargate
options.D: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the output bucket to reduce Fargate spend

questions.question: The Iceland monthly batch tolerates a two-minute Spot interruption warning and retries next month. Which Fargate option best reduces per-run cost?

options.A: Fargate On-Demand with assignPublicIp ENABLED for every private-subnet task
options.B: Fargate Spot capacity on the RunTask / capacity provider strategy
options.C: EC2 Dedicated Hosts reserved for license compliance on the batch worker
options.D: Lambda with a 15-minute timeout covering the full OSM download and transform

questions.question: Night 32 deploys Step Functions while legacy EventBridge rule saa-study-gsa-iceland-monthly still targets ECS directly. Both remain ENABLED. What is the operational risk?

options.A: SQS FIFO ordering breaks for all wiki API traffic in the account
options.B: Two Iceland Fargate tasks may start on the same monthly schedule
options.C: CloudFront invalidates every /api/* path whenever the state machine runs
options.D: Cognito JWTs expire twice as fast for wiki writers and anonymous readers

questions.question: The capstone state uses arn:aws:states:::ecs:runTask.sync. The container exits with code 1 after two Step Functions Retries. Catch routes to PublishFailureAlert (SNS). What happens?

options.A: The execution succeeds because the Retry block already exhausted its attempts
options.B: Catch runs and publishes to the failure topic — Night 14 SNS alert pattern
options.C: SQS moves an unseen completion message into the DLQ without Catch running
options.D: EventBridge FailedInvocations increments even though the ECS target was invoked

questions.question: Which Well-Architected pillar is best demonstrated by Cognito JWT validation on mutating wiki API methods behind API Gateway?

options.A: Sustainability — JWT checks reduce the number of Lambda warm starts
options.B: Security — authenticate and authorize callers before business logic runs
options.C: Cost Optimization — JWT validation removes all API Gateway request charges
options.D: Performance Efficiency — JWT parsing is always faster than any SQL lookup

questions.question: Config reports NON_COMPLIANT on a public S3 bucket that still serves static HTML through CloudFront. Site works. Strongest Security-pillar fix for the edge tier?

options.A: Disable all CloudFront caching behaviors to shrink the HTTP attack surface
options.B: Run Athena nightly on bucket access logs instead of changing bucket policy
options.C: OAC plus block public access — private bucket origin served only via CloudFront
options.D: Move wiki counters from DynamoDB into ElastiCache as the durable source of truth

questions.question: A portfolio reviewer asks where CloudFront ends and ElastiCache begins in GSA. Best answer?

options.A: CloudFront caches HTTP at the edge; Redis caches application objects near Aurora
options.B: They are interchangeable CDN layers — pick whichever is cheaper this month
options.C: ElastiCache replaces Aurora entirely as the system of record for resort_stats
options.D: CloudFront runs inside private subnets beside Lambda for in-VPC edge caching

questions.question: Live wiki visitor counter increments need millisecond writes with ACID. Historical 'resorts per country for three years' runs on S3 Iceberg. Which pairing is correct?

options.A: Athena INSERT for the live counter; ElastiCache alone for the three-year report
options.B: Instance Store for the live counter; Glacier Deep Archive for the report path
options.C: CloudFront invalidation for the live counter; Route 53 geolocation for the report
options.D: DynamoDB for the live counter; Athena SQL on Iceberg for the historical report

questions.question: After lifecycle moves old iceland/ objects to Glacier Flexible Retrieval, finance sees a spike when analysts restore one month for debugging. What exam line item explains the spike?

options.A: NAT Gateway data processing charged per GB of restored Glacier objects
options.B: Fargate Spot interruption fee applied whenever Glacier restores complete
options.C: Glacier retrieval charges — billed separately from storage-class savings
options.D: Intelligent-Tiering monitoring fee assessed on every archived Glacier object

questions.question: Night 9 VPC has one NAT Gateway in public subnet AZ-a. Private subnets span two AZs. Biggest Cost Optimization note while labs are idle but VPC remains?

options.A: NAT Gateway hourly plus per-GB — tear down VPC or add endpoints when pausing
options.B: CloudFront invalidation cost per path dominates idle VPC spend every month
options.C: Route 53 hosted zone charge per wiki record exceeds NAT Gateway idle cost
options.D: Cognito MAU pricing for anonymous static readers is the largest idle VPC tax

questions.question: Step Functions InvokeStatsUploader calls Lambda; the function returns HTTP 200 with body {"error": "no rows"}. No Lambda service exception. What does the Task state do?

options.A: Fails immediately and routes to Catch without attempting any Retry block
options.B: Retries until the runtime throws an AWSLambdaException service fault
options.C: Waits indefinitely for EventBridge FailedInvocations before continuing
options.D: Succeeds — Retry/Catch apply to integration failures, not business errors in JSON

questions.question: Teams want flexible 1-year spend commit across Fargate, Lambda, and EC2 in multiple Regions. Which purchase model fits?

options.A: RDS Reserved Instance applied to the ECS cluster for Fargate discounts
options.B: S3 One Zone-IA storage class for every pipeline output prefix in the account
options.C: EC2 Instance Savings Plan locked to m6i.large in us-east-1a only
options.D: Compute Savings Plan covering Fargate, Lambda, and EC2 across Regions

questions.question: Exam scenario: Route 53 failover from PRIMARY ALB in us-east-1 to SECONDARY in us-west-2. Users must flip automatically when primary is unhealthy. What must exist on the PRIMARY record?

options.A: Geolocation routing policy only — no health check attached to PRIMARY
options.B: Weighted routing at 50/50 with health checks disabled on both records
options.C: Latency-based routing among four Regions without a failover health check
options.D: Health check associated with the PRIMARY failover record for automatic flip

questions.question: Night 23 cache-aside Lambda on cache miss for resort_stats. Correct sequence?

options.A: GET Redis → miss → SELECT Aurora → SETEX Redis → return JSON to the caller
options.B: Redis read-through proxy loads Aurora without any application cache-miss code
options.C: CloudFront invalidates the path first, then Aurora pushes rows into Redis
options.D: SNS fan-out triggers an Aurora write on every Redis cache miss event

questions.question: EventBridge rule targeting ECS shows FailedInvocations alarm. Same night, ECS task logs show container exit code 1. How do you classify the two signals?

options.A: Both signals mean the container failed in exactly the same failure mode
options.B: Both signals mean IAM denied ecs:RunTask before any task could start
options.C: Both signals require configuring an SQS DLQ on the EventBridge rule
options.D: FailedInvocations = rule could not invoke target; exit 1 = task ran and failed

questions.question: Iceland pipeline durable GeoJSON must survive Spot interruption and AZ failure. Temp sort files on the worker can be discarded. Where should durable output live?

options.A: EBS gp3 volume attached for the full lifetime of every batch worker task
options.B: Instance Store alone for maximum sequential throughput as the system of record
options.C: S3 Standard in the pipeline bucket as the durable system of record
options.D: EFS mounted by every Fargate task so workers share one durable output volume

questions.question: Which integration pattern matches ECS task success → durable handoff → Lambda consumer at human-scale throughput?

options.A: SNS topic alone with no queue buffering between producers and consumers
options.B: Kinesis Video Streams ingesting each ECS success event as a media fragment
options.C: EventBridge rule on task success → SQS queue → Lambda event-source poller
options.D: AppSync subscription fired on every S3 PUT to the pipeline output prefix

questions.question: A 2-hour monthly workflow needs per-step Retry/Catch and full execution history for operators. Sub-5-minute Express volume is not required. Pick orchestration.

options.A: Step Functions Express for high-volume short flows with discarded history
options.B: SQS FIFO with content-based deduplication and no shared execution graph
options.C: Step Functions Standard for long runs, Retry/Catch, and durable history
options.D: EventBridge schedule with five independent rules and no shared history

questions.question: Hourly line-item billing exports to S3 for custom Athena cost SQL. Which tool is purpose-built?

options.A: AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) delivering hourly line items into S3
options.B: AWS Budgets with SNS alerts only and no S3 line-item export path
options.C: CloudWatch Logs Insights queries run against the billing console UI
options.D: Macie classification jobs scanning buckets for sensitive cost documents

questions.question: Developer registers Fargate task definition with 2048 CPU units (2 vCPU) and 512 MiB memory. Registration fails. Most likely cause?

options.A: Task role ARN must exactly equal the execution role name for registration
options.B: EventBridge cannot target any Fargate task definition configured above 1 vCPU
options.C: 512 MiB is below the minimum memory allowed for 2 vCPU on Fargate
options.D: awsvpc mode requires assignPublicIp ENABLED to save Fargate compute cost

questions.question: Night 4 attached AWS WAF to the CloudFront distribution for globalskiatlas.com. Which exam domain does this primarily reinforce?

options.A: Cost Optimization — WAF reduces S3 GET charges for every cached object
options.B: Database — WAF caches Aurora query results at the CloudFront edge
options.C: Secure architectures — edge HTTP threat protection with managed rule groups
options.D: Migration — WAF replaces Database Migration Service for ongoing CDC

questions.question: Ongoing replication from on-prem PostgreSQL to Aurora with low-latency CDC. One-time bulk load already finished. Which DMS mode?

options.A: Snowball Edge import only with no ongoing change-data-capture stream
options.B: Athena CTAS statements run directly against the on-premises source database
options.C: S3 Transfer Acceleration used as the primary CDC transport into Aurora
options.D: Full load plus CDC task to keep Aurora updated after the bulk load

questions.question: Aurora cluster needs automatic failover for writer failure in the same Region. Read scaling for reporting is secondary. Minimum configuration?

options.A: Multi-AZ Aurora with writer and reader placed in different Availability Zones
options.B: Single-AZ Aurora relying only on a daily manual snapshot for recovery
options.C: DynamoDB global tables used as the OLTP store for resort_stats instead
options.D: Athena partitioned table treated as the primary OLTP writer endpoint

questions.question: S3 versioning is enabled on a compliance prefix. You want to expire old versions after 90 days but keep current version indefinitely. Which lifecycle feature?

options.A: Noncurrent version transition and expiration rules on the versioned prefix
options.B: Abort incomplete multipart upload rules with no noncurrent version actions
options.C: Cross-Region Replication alone without any lifecycle expiration configuration
options.D: Disable versioning and rely only on Intelligent-Tiering for old object cleanup

questions.question: Private subnet Fargate tasks pull container images and write pipeline output without public IPs. Which networking combination reduces NAT data processing?

options.A: S3 gateway endpoint plus ECR interface endpoint — NAT only for other internet
options.B: 0.0.0.0/0 on the task security group to simplify outbound path selection
options.C: Public subnet placement with assignPublicIp DISABLED for every Fargate task
options.D: Remove all route tables so tasks rely on Instance Store for network routing

questions.question: Millions of sub-3-minute payment authorization flows per day; no requirement to retain execution history beyond minutes. Orchestration pick?

options.A: Step Functions Standard with one-year execution history retention enabled
options.B: Step Functions Express for high-volume short flows with optional discarded history
options.C: Always-on ECS service driving a Step Functions Map across 10,000 child states
options.D: SQS standard queue with no consumers and no workflow orchestration service

questions.question: You pause all study labs for three weeks. Which teardown step saves the most idle spend while keeping prod CloudFront and wiki API running?

options.A: Delete WAF on the production CloudFront distribution before pausing labs
options.B: Remove the Cognito user pool that production wiki writers still depend on
options.C: Run night-34 master teardown through Aurora/ElastiCache/NAT — keep prod edge
options.D: Delete all S3 objects in the pipeline bucket including the current month prefix

questions.question: Practice Exam 1 tonight: 65 questions in 130 minutes. You score 44/65. Best next move before scheduling the real SAA-C03?

options.A: Schedule the real exam for tomorrow — 44/65 is close enough to sit now
options.B: Skip Night 35 entirely and take Practice Exam 2 with no weak-area review
options.C: Memorize every AWS service name alphabetically before any more practice exams
options.D: Night 35 weak-area drill on top 3 missed domains — target ≥75% on Exam 2
